mapper.select: SELECT id, openid, unionid, nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, gender, city, country, province, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, last_login_time AS lastLoginTime FROM wx_user WHERE openid = #{openid}

SELECT id, openid, unionid, nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, gender, city, country, province, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, last_login_time AS lastLoginTime FROM wx_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wx_user (openid, unionid, nickname, avatar_url, gender, city, country, province) VALUES (#{openid}, #{unionid}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{gender}, #{city}, #{country}, #{province})
mapper.update: UPDATE wx_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, gender = #{gender}, city = #{city}, country = #{country}, province = #{province}, last_login_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
